notes: The 'Point Score by Variable' PDO (Point-to-Double-the-Odds) scorecard scoring DATA step is byte-identical to the source. The source read 'ddata.model_score' from an external libname (C:\test_SC_CS, not available here), so this bundle supplies a 5-row mock model_score dataset with the same column shape the step expects (odds + var_1 through var_6). The source file's later exploratory sections - a 30-million-row synthetic PROC SQL sweep over a 'limit' variable and a 300-row 'util' sweep, both building lookup tables rather than reusable logic - were not included; the point-scoring DATA step is the complete, reusable technique from this file.
